title: Australian Kung Fu Nun Chickens. Mixed reality. Wishlist now! 15% from the very first dollar to charity and then blender and Godot foundations.
author: HeyYou_GetOffMyCloud
selftext:
https://www.meta.com/experiences/1431966456660002/

www.nunchooks.com

G'day! I'm Jack, from Queensland, and the wishlist store page for my game "NUNCHOOKS: Way of the Warrior Hen" went live today.

An evil mysterious dropbear has spread blight across Australia and has sent the wildlife feral. He's captured and caged your six kungfu obsessed sisters. You start as Sister Kylie and vow that you'll save your sisters and fight the blight with your trusty nunchucks. 

I've made a campaign mode with 7 levels with a boss at the end of each level. Beat the boss and you free your sister who you can play as or bring with you to carry on the fight. 

It works with hands or controllers, your pick. Seated or standing. 

The fun isn't over once the campaign is done though, Ive made an Endless mode that's a roguelite deck-builder (sorry, I know it's cliche but it is fun), plus a daily run and leaderboards.

After each boss fight you head back home to the coop. Upgrade it to get buffs in the game. Bazza the Brushtail possums fixes the coop up for you in exchange for mangos.  

Made with Godot, Blender, Tripo, Claude and ChatGPT. Claude helps me write the code, and a lot of the art and models start in ChatGPT and Tripo before I fix them up in Blender. I have 15 years of CGI experience and 20 years of failing to learn how to code. 

If you like the binding of Isaac, slay the spire and the cult of the lamb, I thnk you'll like this. (FAr more family friendly though) If it looks like your sort of thing, a wishlist helps heaps:

Happy to answer anything. I'd love to hear what looks wrong now than after launch.

I plan on updating the store page images and video as I continue to work on the game.
